attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 15, `mdtN` to `actP`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 12% of calls. The model names 90 to 99% of them, fewest at column 4, `yjcO`, 90%.

**A variable column breaks the spine at 16**, `espX5`, carried by 66%. Through columns 61 to 67 a branch of 7 shell families runs in 26 to 30%, [[mannose and sorbose transport]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 95 against 91%, and hesitates less there, 0.23 against 0.41 bits. It hesitates most at column 28, `yjbS`, a variable column, 1.08 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 35 to 79 are carried by 33 to 87% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 12 to 36% of calls. The last column is `yjaG`, in 35% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 93% of genes**, 0.34 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.00 against 0.24 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 96%.

label: mdtN
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the mdtN window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor mdtN, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,043 to 4,122 from dnaA. Read in 527 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying mdtN once); 42,160 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.34 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,615 calls, named 98%, 0.17 bits; shell 8,066 calls, named 73%, 0.89 bits; cloud 479 calls, named 18%, 2.96 bits. Outside an RGP 36,573 calls, named 96%, 0.24 bits; inside an RGP 5,587 calls, named 71%, 1.00 bits. Columns: 32 spine, 11 fork, 37 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.00 against 0.24 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 96%); 5,587 of the 42,160 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 28 (yjbS, a variable column) 1.08 bits, RGP 5%; column 35 (zur, a fork column) 0.92 bits, RGP 21%; column 27 (aphA, a spine column) 0.86 bits, RGP 5%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 32 spine columns: named 95%, 0.23 bits on average; the 48 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.41 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 28, is a variable column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-15 (16 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-12%. Genes: mdtN, mdtO "multidrug efflux transporter permea…", mdtP, fdhF, yjcO "Sel1 family TPR-like repeat protein…", gltP, nrfG, nrfF, nrfE, nrfD, nrfC, nrfB, nrfA "ammonia-forming nitrite reductase c…", acs, yjcH "DUF485 domain-containing protein", actP. named 90-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 4 (yjcO), named 90%; most hesitant at column 1 (mdtO), 0.59 bits.
[S2] 2. column 16 variable: share 66%, all S, RGP 0.4%. named 82%; 0.80 bits.
[S2.c16]    16: espX5 S 66%
[S3] 3. columns 17-20 (4 columns) spine: share 97%, all P, RGP 0.4-2%. Genes: yjcE "Na+/H+ antiporter", ghxP, soxR "redox-sensitive transcriptional act…", soxS. named 96-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 20 (soxS), named 96%, 0.27 bits.
[S4] 4. column 21 variable: share 87%, all S, RGP 4%. named 85%; 0.78 bits.
[S4.c21]    21: pdeC S 87%
[S5] 5. columns 22-27 (6 columns) spine: share 91-97%, all P, RGP 4-5%. Genes: yjcB "YjcB family protein", ssb1, uvrA, yjbR "MmcQ/YjbR family DNA-binding protein", yjbQ "secondary thiamine-phosphate syntha…", aphA. named 85-97% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 27 (aphA), named 85%, 0.86 bits.
[S6] 6. column 28 variable: share 46%, all S, RGP 5%. named 85%; 1.08 bits.
[S6.c28]    28: yjbS S 46% "protein YjbS"
[S7] 7. columns 29-34 (6 columns) spine: share 96-97%, all P, RGP 3-11%. Genes: tyrB, alr, dnaB, qorA, pspG, dusA. named 82-97% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 34 (dusA), named 82%, 0.67 bits.
[S8] 8. columns 35-79 (45 columns) fork and variable columns: share 33-87%, 41 P, 4 S, RGP 12-36%. named 83-95% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 35, named 83%, 0.92 bits.
[S8.b61]    a second branch of 7 families through columns 61-67, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 26-30%, all S; the branch's families: sorC, sorD, sorF, sorB, sorA, "PTS system mannose/fructose/sorbose fam…", sorE
[S8.c35]    35 fork: zur P 87%; also "DinI-like family protein" S 11%
[S8.c36]    36 variable: yjbJ P 87% "CsbD family protein"
[S8.c37]    37 fork: dinF P 87%; also "Ldh family oxidoreductase" S 10%

[S8.c43]    43 fork: malM P 86%; also espX4 S 28%, "IS1 family transposase" S 23%
[S8.c44-60]    columns 44-60 variable, share 57-87%, 15 P, 2 S: lamB 87%, malK "maltose/maltodextrin ABC transporte…" 86%, malE 86%, malF 86%, malG 86%, xylE 60%, psiE 86%, "hypothetical protein" 57%, "periplasmic protein" 85%, yjbH "YjbH domain-containing protein" 85%, yjbG "capsule biosynthesis GfcC family pr…" 86%, yjbF "YjbF family lipoprotein" 85%, yjbE "exopolysaccharide production protei…" 86%, pgi 86%, lysC 85%, yjbD "DUF3811 domain-containing protein" 85%, rluF 81%
